outcome: The journey stage derives from ONE published, versioned threshold set (JOURNEY_KIND, an r2-published document kind whose every revision carries its own stamped version identity) over visit-local counters, using the one shared stage vocabulary JOURNEY_STAGES = ['exploring','thinking','deciding'] in that order. The thresholds are data, not constants: the same counters under two published sets give two stages. The validator refuses, returning EVERY error, a stage word outside the vocabulary, stages out of vocabulary order, a threshold on the first stage, a fractional or negative threshold, a counter the visit does not keep, and a stage with no threshold at all.
